reason: The requirements and acceptance criteria (R1-R10, AC1-AC9) this task implements: coexist both auth modes, login default=user, browser+paste channels, refresh, backward-compat (legacy enterprise inference), USER-only gating on held kind. Read before touching any auth/config code.

The technical decisions (D1-D14) to implement exactly: two-slot Config model (D1), active-mode inference (D2), coercion (D3), AuthSession.mode + Ctx.oauth (D4), mode-aware persistToken (D5), acquireUserToken/refreshUserToken (D6), mode-aware ensureFreshToken (D7), http.ts untouched (D8), refuseUserTokenEndpoint gating (D9), login mode+channel prompts (D10-D12), loopback capture (D13), status/logout (D14).

Extend here: TokenRecord gains kind+refreshToken (D1); Config gains oauthRedirectUri/userToken/authMode (D1); coerceToken/coerceConfig must accept them and default kind='enterprise' for legacy (D3); resolveSettings derives authMode via D2 inference. Existing loadConfig/saveConfig/saveConfig merge reused.
AuthSession gains `mode` (D4); Ctx gains `oauth:{redirectUri?}` (D4). createContext defaults auth.mode. This is what makes gating (D9) and refresh routing (D7) deterministic instead of guessed.

Add acquireUserToken (authorization_code exchange, D6) and refreshUserToken (refresh_token, D6, SAME refreshToken retained); make ensureFreshToken mode-aware (D7) routing enterprise->acquireToken, user->refreshUserToken; TokenResponse gains refresh_token. Keep normalizeExpiry/ensureFreshToken single-inflight pattern. Legacy coerce default kind='enterprise'.

buildContext stamps ctx.auth.mode and loads the ACTIVE slot (D5); make persistToken mode-aware (route by token.kind to the right config slot + stamp authMode). test/globals.test.ts must gain a user-kind persistToken case.

runLogin: add --mode (default user, D10) + mode prompt; channel prompt browser/paste (D12); authorize URL + two code-acquisition branches (D12); user verification via /v1/myself (D12 step 6). runStatus reports authMode/kind/refresh presence (D14); runLogout clears active slot + --all both (D14). Enterprise branch untouched (D11).

runVerb already builds ctx (line ~247); thread it into refuseUserTokenEndpoint and gate USER-only on ctx.auth.mode==='user' (D9). Update AUTHORIZE_HINT + tokenLine/warningsFor copy. Note CatalogTokenType APP/ENT/USER and the 3 documented auth-token grants in catalog.generated.ts.

Already documents authorization_code (needs code) and refresh_token (needs refresh_token) grants; /oauth2/authorize excluded by design (D2.8). Reference only — do NOT hand-edit (generated by scripts/catalog-sync.ts).

createFakeFetch/createTestContext/jsonResponse/emptyResponse fixtures for faking the token endpoint, the authorize/exchange, and refresh WITHOUT network. CreateTestContext supports env+apiBase; extend if a loopback seam is needed for captureCodeFromLoopback.

Existing acquireToken/ensureFreshToken/inflight-serialization coverage to extend: add acquireUserToken query-shape + refresh_token capture (B2), refreshUserToken same-refreshToken (B3), mode-aware ensureFreshToken routing + refresh-failure AuthError (B4), user-mode 401 behavior.
persistToken merges only {token} today — add the user-kind case (writes userToken, stamps authMode) and D2 inference cases if not placed in config.test.ts.
401 single-replay + no-recursion loop is mode-agnostic (D8); add a user-mode 401 replay case if cheap. Bearer injection unchanged.
